title: Motion Snippets
description: Explore robot motion clips with Unitree G1, A1, and Boston Dynamics Spot. Replay joint trajectories with MuJoCo physics in your browser.

title: Motion Planning
description: Follow a Franka arm’s path from endpoint poses to an optimized trajectory. Inspect the factor graph, solver iterations, and joint motion.

title: Contact Initialization
description: Explore a C++ GTSAM alternative to IK initialization. Replay native solves and timings, compare contact models, and switch between G1 walking and a longer captured motion.
